title: Animal Sorting · Habitat
instructions: Drag each animal into the habitat where it usually lives. Some habitats may have more than one animal.

bins.name: Water
bins.description: Lives in water, like ponds, rivers, or seas.

bins.name: Air / Tree
bins.description: Spends most life flying or on tree branches.

bins.name: Both Land and Water
bins.description: Lives partly on land and partly in water.

items.name: Cow
items.explanation: Cows are mammals that live on land and graze on plants.

items.name: Sparrow
items.explanation: Sparrows can fly and rest on trees and rooftops.

items.name: Eagle
items.explanation: Eagles soar in the air and nest on tall trees or cliffs.

items.name: Fish
items.explanation: Fish live in water and breathe through gills.

items.name: Whale
items.explanation: Whales live in the ocean (though they are mammals that breathe air).

items.name: Frog
items.explanation: Frogs are amphibians and live both on land and in water.

items.name: Turtle
items.explanation: Many turtles live in water and come to land to lay eggs.

items.name: Lizard
items.explanation: Lizards are reptiles that live on land, often near walls and rocks.
